description: End-to-end telecom billing and revenue assurance workflow from configuration discovery to leakage detection, correction, and recovery.

network_element_id.description: Unique identifier of a network element (e.g., MSC, PGW, GGSN, OCS, PCRF).

billing_profile_id.description: Identifier for a billing configuration profile or tariff plan.

usage_sample_batch_id.description: Identifier for a collected batch of usage samples or CDRs.

discrepancy_case_id.description: Identifier for a detected revenue discrepancy case.

remediation_plan_id.description: Identifier for a generated remediation plan to fix discrepancies.

rollback_plan_id.description: Identifier for a generated rollback plan for configuration changes.

job_id.description: Identifier for asynchronous jobs (collection, analysis, simulation, remediation).

from.description: Start of the time window (inclusive, UTC).

to.description: End of the time window (exclusive, UTC).

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: discover_billing_topology
functions.description: Discover and retrieve current billing-related network topology, including network elements, charging domains, and linked billing profiles.

regions.description: List of region or market identifiers to limit discovery.

element_types.description: Types of network elements to include.

include_inactive.description: Whether to include inactive or decommissioned elements.

include_details.description: Additional details to include in discovery output.

functions.returns: Discovered topology including list of network elements, their roles, connectivity, and associated billing profiles.

functions.name: get_billing_profile
functions.description: Retrieve details of a specific billing profile, including rating rules, thresholds, and mapping to network elements.

as_of.description: Timestamp for configuration version (for historical or scheduled changes).

functions.returns: Full billing profile definition including rating rules, mapping to services and network elements, and optional historical/audit information.

functions.name: collect_usage_samples
functions.description: Initiate collection of usage samples (CDRs/UDRs) from selected network elements for a given time window and subscriber segment.

network_elements.description: List of network element IDs to collect from. If omitted, inferred from billing profiles or scope.

billing_profiles.description: Optional billing profiles to constrain collection to specific tariffs or offers.

subscriber_filter.description: Filter which subscribers or traffic to collect.

imsi_prefixes.description: Limit to subscribers whose IMSI starts with one of these prefixes.

sample_strategy.description: Sampling parameters to limit data volume.

target_records.description: Approximate number of records to collect.

functions.returns: Job descriptor including job_id, estimated completion time, and resulting usage_sample_batch_id (once available).

functions.name: get_job_status
functions.description: Retrieve status and progress information for a long-running job such as collection, analysis, simulation, or remediation.

job_id.description: Identifier of the job to query.

include_history.description: Whether to include historical state transitions for the job.

functions.returns: Job status including state, progress percentage, timestamps, recent log messages, and any produced entity IDs (e.g., usage_sample_batch_id, remediation_plan_id).

functions.name: run_leakage_analysis
functions.description: Run a revenue leakage analysis on collected usage samples and billing profiles to detect discrepancies between expected and actual charging.

usage_sample_batch_id.description: Identifier of the usage sample batch to analyze.

reference_billing_profiles.description: Billing profiles to use as reference for expected rating. If omitted, auto-detected.

analysis_scope.description: Define which discrepancy types to search for.

thresholds.description: Monetary and count thresholds for flagging discrepancies.

min_amount_per_case.description: Minimum absolute revenue impact to open a discrepancy case.

min_total_batch_impact.description: Minimum total impact across batch to treat as significant.

min_cdr_count.description: Minimum number of affected CDRs per case.

simulation_mode.description: How expected charges are computed versus live systems.

functions.returns: Job descriptor including job_id and, upon completion, a summary of detected discrepancies and created discrepancy_case_ids.

functions.name: list_discrepancy_cases
functions.description: List discrepancy cases created by leakage analysis, filterable by severity, status, and timeframe.
functions.returns: Paged list of discrepancy cases with basic attributes and potential revenue impact per case.

functions.name: get_discrepancy_case_details
functions.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific discrepancy case, including sample CDRs, computed vs billed charges, and suspected root cause.

cdr_sample_limit.description: Maximum number of CDR samples to return if requested.

functions.returns: Detailed view of the discrepancy case, including monetary impact, root cause hypotheses, and references to usage records.

functions.name: simulate_billing_adjustment
functions.description: Simulate configuration changes or billing profile adjustments to estimate impact on revenue and subscriber charges before applying changes.

billing_profile_id.description: Primary billing profile to simulate changes for.

discrepancy_case_id.description: Optional discrepancy case as focus for simulation.

usage_sample_batch_id.description: Optional batch of usage samples for what-if simulation.

proposed_changes.description: List of proposed configuration changes to simulate.

change_id.description: Client-supplied local identifier for this change.

entity_key.description: Identifier or natural key of the rule/policy being changed.

current_value_snapshot.description: Snapshot of current configuration (for audit and rollback).

proposed_value.description: Proposed new configuration object. Shape depends on entity_type.

traffic_growth_factor.description: Multiplier to scale usage volumes (e.g., 1.1 for +10%).

time_horizon_days.description: Number of days to extrapolate revenue impact.

functions.returns: Job descriptor including job_id; once completed, provides estimated revenue impact, distribution across segments, and risk indicators.

functions.name: generate_remediation_plan
functions.description: Generate a remediation plan for a discrepancy case, including configuration changes and optional customer-level adjustments.

backbilling_policy.description: Applicable if backbilling or credits are part of strategy.

no_downtime_windows.description: Time windows when changes must not be activated.

functions.returns: Generated remediation_plan_id and plan summary including list of proposed steps, their dependencies, and estimated recovered or refunded amounts.

functions.name: apply_remediation_plan
functions.description: Execute a remediation plan, optionally in phased batches, and track execution status and errors.

remediation_plan_id.description: Identifier of the remediation plan to apply.

phase_size.description: Number of subscribers or impacted accounts per phase.

start_time.description: Optional start time for first phase.

stop_on_error_rate.description: Abort if error rate exceeds this fraction (e.g., 0.05 for 5%).

ticket_reference.description: External change request or incident ticket ID.

functions.returns: Job descriptor including job_id and initial execution status, with references to impacted network elements and subscribers.

functions.name: create_rollback_plan
functions.description: Create a rollback plan for configuration changes introduced by a remediation plan, enabling safe reversal if issues occur.

remediation_plan_id.description: Remediation plan whose config changes should be reversible.

include_subscriber_adjustments.description: Whether to attempt to reverse monetary adjustments as well.

limit_to_failed_steps.description: If true, only generate rollback for failed or partially applied steps.

risk_tolerance.description: Controls how much automation vs manual confirmation is required.

functions.returns: rollback_plan_id and summary of rollbackable entities, dependencies, and any manual steps required.

functions.name: execute_rollback_plan
functions.description: Execute a rollback plan to revert billing configuration changes or monetary adjustments made by a remediation plan.

rollback_plan_id.description: Identifier of the rollback plan to execute.

target_entities.description: Optional list of specific entities (rules, subscribers) to rollback.

functions.returns: Job descriptor including job_id; once completed, provides rollback execution report with success/failure per entity and residual risk.

functions.name: retry_failed_operation
functions.description: Retry failed steps in a previous remediation or rollback job with adjusted parameters or narrowed scope.

job_id.description: Identifier of the original remediation or rollback job.

include_error_types.description: Error types to include in retry.

limit_entities.description: Optional cap on number of entities to retry.

override_parameters.description: Optional overrides for execution behavior on retry.

initiated_by.description: User or system initiating the retry.

functions.returns: New job_id for the retry operation and a summary of which entities or steps are scheduled for retry.

functions.name: search_revenue_assurance_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across revenue_assurance entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching revenue_assurance entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_revenue_assurance_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N revenue_assurance records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_revenue_assurance_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many revenue_assurance records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_revenue_assurance_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many revenue_assurance records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_revenue_assurance_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of revenue_assurance data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_revenue_assurance_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a revenue_assurance dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_revenue_assurance_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more revenue_assurance entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_revenue_assurance_snapshot
functions.description: Restore revenue_assurance state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_revenue_assurance_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the revenue_assurance workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_revenue_assurance_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across revenue_assurance metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_revenue_assurance_audit_events
functions.description: Search the revenue_assurance audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_revenue_assurance_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers revenue_assurance workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_revenue_assurance_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for revenue_assurance events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_revenue_assurance_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for revenue_assurance events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_revenue_assurance_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off revenue_assurance job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_revenue_assurance_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled revenue_assurance jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_revenue_assurance_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled revenue_assurance job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_revenue_assurance_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a revenue_assurance operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_revenue_assurance_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a revenue_assurance action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_revenue_assurance_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a revenue_assurance approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_revenue_assurance_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any revenue_assurance entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_revenue_assurance_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a revenue_assurance entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_revenue_assurance_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling revenue_assurance behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_revenue_assurance_policies
functions.description: List revenue_assurance policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_revenue_assurance_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two revenue_assurance-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_revenue_assurance_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a revenue_assurance entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_revenue_assurance_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many revenue_assurance entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.
